title: event.v2
description: A producer's fact into flows (`POST /events`) carrying a SEALED fact envelope (PRD 0.13.4 D8): the producing domain computes who the fact reaches (`audience`), whose it is (`owner`) and at what visibility, and seals it with a per-producer HMAC. flows strips any `_audience`/`_owner`/`_visibility`/`_lifecycle` a caller puts in `refs`, verifies the envelope (`fact_envelope.verify`), and admits a person's flow when the person is the subject (`refs.uid`) or in the audience. Refs are references, never bodies (M5); the envelope's keys are enumerated and a card's lifecycle coordination fields are the only card fields it may carry (C8). The seal itself is checked by `fact_envelope.py`, not by this schema.

Lifecycle.description: A card's coordination fields — the ONLY card fields a fact may carry (C8). Never a title, a summary or any other content.

Envelope.description: The sealed fact envelope. `sig` = hex Ed25519 signature (128 hex digits) over the canonical JSON (sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8) of `{"envelope": <the envelope without sig>, "fact": {"event_type", "source_event_id", "refs"}}` — the seal covers the fact it rides on — made with the named producer's own private key and verified under that producer's public key.

owner.description: The person id who owns the object.

audience.description: Person ids the fact reaches, and `ws:<slug>` for a workspace principal (which never matches a person).

exp.description: Unix seconds after which the seal is refused; the seal sets it 300 s ahead and verify refuses one further ahead than that (60 s skew).

Event.description: The `POST /events` body a sealing producer sends.

refs.description: References only (M5). The keys `_audience`, `_owner`, `_visibility`, `_lifecycle` are reserved: flows drops them from every caller and sets them only from a verified envelope.
